crossRefs.note: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

translations.web: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”
translations.bsb: And you shall eat the food as you would a barley cake, after you bake it over dried human excrement in the sight of the people.”
translations.kjv: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
translations.asv: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it in their sight with dung that cometh out of man.
